content: You have a sovereign right over your labor, but never over the fruits thereof.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Karmanyevadhikaraste ma phaleshu kadachana (कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन) — Bhagavad Gita II.47
explanation: Anxiety is born when we obsess over future outcomes—reputation, wealth, victory—which lie entirely beyond human control. Sovereign peace is claimed the moment you pour 100% of your craftsmanship into the immediate action, leaving the fruits in the hands of destiny.
practicalInsight: Give your absolute finest effort to your current project today, and deliberately detach your self-worth from whether it receives applause.
reflectionPrompt: How would the quality of your daily work transform if you cared only for the integrity of the act itself?
